description: NARRATIVE STRUCTURE = COLLAPSE OVER A STORY-GRAMMAR CODEBOOK, one level up from discourse_coherence's span-pair coherence-relation collapse (which is itself one level up from reading_collapse's clause-construction collapse). Where discourse_coherence decodes the RELATION between two spans, this codebook decodes the STORY-GRAMMAR ROLE of ONE event/sentence in a character's GOAL-PURSUIT chain (Rumelhart/Mandler-Johnson story grammar; Trabasso & van den Broek's causal network read one level up: goal -> obstacle -> attempt -> outcome). Every position in the chain (the goal-establishing sentence, then each of the goal-holder's own later action sentences -- comprehension_reader._mint_goal_action_enabling_chain's own already-decided backbone, reused verbatim, never re-derived) is turned into a SINGLE-TOKEN skeleton by a mechanical graph read (does this sentence carry a goal already minted by inference_generation.resolve_goal_gap? does an EARLIER sentence attach to it via discourse_coherence's own decoded 'contrast' relation -- the textual signal of a complication/obstacle? does this sentence carry an outgoing 'causes' edge -- inference_generation.resolve_causal_gap's own physical-effect chain -- toward a later sentence? does a downstream effect sentence's own recognised words include the goal's remedy token?), and that ONE token is decoded against this codebook exactly the way discourse_coherence.coherence_between decodes a marker/signal token against ShapeSignatureCoherence -- the ROLE ITSELF is always the winning ShapeSignatureNarrative's own `role` attr, never a Python if/else naming the role directly. TERMINOLOGY COLLISION: 'narrative' here (and in the other narrative_* seeds -- narrative_convention.json, narrative_tropes.json) means literary story grammar (Rumelhart/Mandler-Johnson goal-obstacle-attempt-outcome chains in a text). In the theory papers (~/law_of_narrative_inertia_v2.tex), 'Narrative' (n_{W:G,t}) means the continuation vector a containing frame represents about a situated graph, distinct from that graph's own self-prediction -- the thing momentum grounds. Unrelated mechanisms; neither is evidence for the other. See docs/research/theory_convergence/GRAPHIC_EQUALISATION_V22_SUBSTRATE_GAP.md §10.

microtheory.name: narrative_structure
microtheory.description: The fable/story-grammar arc (setup/problem/solution/action/consequence/resolution) recognised over the comprehension graph's already-built goal + causal/enabling chain + discourse-coherence graph, by ShapeDecode against a dedicated ShapeSignatureNarrative codebook -- one level up from coherence relations, itself one level up from clause constructions.

attrs.name: setup
attrs.note: The goal-establishing sentence/event: a character SmEntity carries a GOAL already minted by inference_generation.resolve_goal_gap (goal-from-state, e.g. thirsty->drink). Token is a constant for this slot -- no mechanical ambiguity, so no branching is needed to produce it (the goal was already decided by resolve_goal_gap's own decode, reused here verbatim).

attrs.name: problem
attrs.note: An action-chain sentence whose INCOMING discourse_coherence relation (from an earlier sentence, read off discourse_coherence.read_discourse's own already-decoded `pairs`) is 'contrast' -- the textual signal ('But...') of a complication set against the just-stated goal. The complication/obstacle IS the discourse-coherence layer's own decode; this module only reads which token that decode already assigned.

attrs.name: solution
attrs.note: An action-chain sentence that carries an OUTGOING 'causes' edge (inference_generation.resolve_causal_gap's own physical-effect decode, or discourse_coherence's own marked/unmarked cause decode -- reused, not re-derived) toward a later DiscourseEvent: the goal-pursuit ATTEMPT that the story's own causal network already traces forward to a consequence.

attrs.name: action
attrs.note: An action-chain sentence with NEITHER an incoming contrast NOR an outgoing causal edge -- a bare goal-pursuit attempt (Trabasso & van den Broek's ATTEMPT node) the story's own coherence/causal decode did not further distinguish as an obstacle or a causal hinge. The GENERAL, honest fallback role for a shorter/partial arc (e.g. the wolf's 'chased the lamb', which never resolves into a stated outcome).

attrs.name: consequence
attrs.note: The target sentence of a 'solution' event's outgoing 'causes' edge, whose own recognised words do NOT (yet) include the goal's remedy token -- a real causal consequence, but not confirmed as the goal being MET. Weaker than 'resolution', included so a causal chain that stops short of an explicit goal-satisfying token is still honestly recorded rather than silently dropped.

attrs.name: resolution
attrs.note: A causal-chain effect sentence whose own recognised words (comprehend_text._recognise_words, the SAME recognition tokenizer reading_collapse/discourse_coherence already use -- no regex) include the goal's own remedy token (the schema-supplied remedy inference_generation.resolve_goal_gap already decided, e.g. 'drink') -- the goal-pursuit's OUTCOME: the goal is achieved, read off already-committed facts (the remedy word, the causal chain), never guessed.
